artworks.title: Guillaume du Vair
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, shown from the chest upwards. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. The man has distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose and a long beard. His hair is styled back and relatively short. He is wearing a coat with a large fur collar over clothing that includes a high, white collar visible around his neck. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame adorned with scrollwork and a crown above the man's head. There is intricate engraving surrounding the frame. Latin text is inscribed below the image. The background is simple, emphasizing the portrait and the decorative frame.

artworks.title: René Descartes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.4 x 13.8 cm (7 5/8 x 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting sideways on a chair with one arm resting on a table. He has long hair, a mustache, arched eyebrows, and is dressed in formal attire. The chair has turned legs and a low back, and the table is covered with a patterned cloth. The man holds a quill, with books on the table and floor, and a shelf of books behind him. A round-topped hat is on the table to the left, and the background has vertical lines.

artworks.title: Louis de Blois
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust of a man shown from the chest up in a classic three-quarter view. He has a serious expression, with a high forehead, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and is wearing a hooded robe. He is holding a quill pen in his right hand, poised over an open book with Latin text. Books are visible on a shelf in the background. The scene is framed by an ornate oval border with floral ornaments and decorative scrolls, and Latin inscriptions provide context around the frame.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait. The individual is positioned facing the viewer. They have a rounded face, almond-shaped eyes, a closed mouth, and their hair is covered by a large headpiece. They are wearing a dark garment with a high collar and a geometric pattern, featuring a wide collar extending over their shoulders. The background has a pattern of fleur-de-lis symbols. The border around the image is oval, framing the figure centrally. There is text identifying the individual as Anne d'Autriche, Queen Regent of France and Navarre.

artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a young male figure with wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is dressed in a garment with lace details and intricate embroidery. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with two heraldic crests at the top corners. The background has a textured pattern typical of engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Jean Le Feron
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man showing his bust, with his upper torso visible. He is positioned facing slightly to his right while looking directly at the viewer. The man has a prominent mustache and a voluminous hairstyle that falls to his shoulders, characterized by loose curls. He is dressed in traditional attire, including a large collar and a buttoned doublet or coat. The fabric appears richly textured. Around his neck, there appears to be a decorative bow or tie. The man is not shown wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. In the background, behind the man’s right shoulder, there is a scene depicting hunting or a countryside landscape, including trees and a running animal. The top corners of the image feature decorative elements, with a coat of arms in the top left and a laurel wreath emblem on the top right. The border of the image is oval-shaped.

artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in ornate armor with long curly hair, a prominent mustache, and a pointed beard. He is positioned slightly turned to the left, looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. His hand rests on a baton, and a cross of the Order is visible on his chest. The background depicts a scene that seems like a battle or military camp, with clouds and distant landscape elements. The portrait is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Philippe Emmanuel, Count of Ligneville
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body facing slightly to the side, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a mustache, goatee, and curly hair falling over his shoulders. The man wears ornate armor with a cloth draped over one shoulder. In the background, there is an oval-shaped frame with a textured backdrop and a tassel. A crest is in the top left corner, and a decorative wreath in the top right corner. Text below the portrait identifies him as Philippe Emanuel, Comte de Ligniville.

artworks.title: Jacques de la Force
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in an ornate frame. The man is seated, facing the viewer. He has a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, a mustache extending into a short, full beard, curly shoulder-length hair styled back, and is wearing an elaborate ruff around his neck. He is draped in a detailed garment, suggesting wealth or status. In the background, there is a scene of battle with smoke, figures on horseback, buildings, and a tassel near the top of the frame.

artworks.title: Louis XIV, King of France
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate portrait showing an upper-body view of a seated young person. The individual has long, curled hair, a smooth face, slightly arched eyebrows, and a direct gaze. They are dressed in an elaborate garment with a large decorative bow on the shoulder and a richly adorned cloak fastened by a brooch. The person is holding a staff or scepter in their right hand, and a crown is placed on a small table to their left. The background includes architectural elements and a cityscape with sailing vessels. An oval frame with intricate details surrounds the portrait.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait from the waist up of a woman. She is positioned slightly to the side, looking towards the viewer. Her facial features include full lips, a straight nose, and arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled in tight curls that fall around her shoulders. She is dressed in an elaborate gown with an ornate bodice adorned with jewels and fine details. A necklace made of pearls is visible around her neck, and she wears a matching pair of earrings. The backdrop is a draped fabric with a pattern of fleur-de-lis, and to the top left, there is an emblem with a crown. The background also includes a cloud-like design.

artworks.title: Louis II de Bourbon-Condé
artworks.description: The image displays a bust-length portrait of a person identified as Louis de Bourbon, Duc d'Enghien. The individual faces slightly to their right, with their face turned towards the viewer. They have distinctive facial features characterized by a prominent nose and lips, and their hair is long, falling in curls around their shoulders. The individual is adorned in decorated armor with intricate detailing and a patterned, wide-collared piece. The background shows a busy battle scene with clouds above and numerous figures engaged in combat, labeled "la Bataille de Rocroy." The sketch is highly detailed, with a rich texture indicative of engraving.

artworks.title: Isabelle Claire Eugénie
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's half-body portrait. She is standing with her body facing forward and her face slightly turned towards the viewer. Her facial features are defined, with prominent eyes and a straight mouth. She has a serious expression and her hair is covered by a hood. The woman is dressed in a religious habit, which includes a veil and a robe, with a visible cincture or rope belt around her waist. She is holding a rosary with one hand, and her other hand rests on a book. The background shows an outdoor setting with trees, and a glimpse of architecture resembling a grand building or palace in the distance. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame, and there are decorative elements and text beneath the image.

artworks.title: Wolfgang Wilhelm
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with curly hair, a mustache, and a beard styled in 17th-century upper-class attire. He is wearing a decorated garment with a stiff collar, and a chain of office. The background shows an outdoor landscape with trees, a river, and buildings. The oval frame around the portrait includes the name "WOLFGANGUS WILHELMUS" and his title.

artworks.title: Louis II de Bourbon-Condé
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a person with a dignified appearance. The person is facing slightly to their right, looking directly at the viewer. They have a smooth complexion, large almond-shaped eyes, and long curly hair. The individual is dressed in ornate clothing typical of nobility or royalty from the past, including a large lace collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. In the background is a detailed scene of a town or city with figures, carriages, and architectural structures in a classical style, providing historical context.

artworks.title: François de Vendôme, Duke of Beaufort
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in a three-quarter view, with distinct facial features and long hair. He wears elaborate 17th-century clothing, potentially indicating nobility or a military connection. The man is depicted within an ornate, octagonal frame with intricate designs. In the background, there is a scene with trees and possibly a distant landscape visible through a window or opening. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the man's hands.

artworks.title: Guido Bentivoglio
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper torso and head. The man has a high forehead, receding hairline, prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a neatly groomed beard and mustache. He wears a garment with a wide, turned-up collar and buttons. The background consists of finely etched lines and the engraving includes text beneath the portrait identifying the man.

artworks.title: Robert de Sorbon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward with closed eyes and has a small moustache, wavy hair, and a rounded hat. He is wearing a robe with an ermine-trimmed collar. The background features a lush landscape with trees. The portrait is framed in an oval with text at the bottom identifying the person as Robert Sorbon.

artworks.title: Jean-François Bagni
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man seated and facing slightly to his left. He has a pointed mustache and a small goatee, with short hair styled back. He wears a dark garment with a high, light-colored collar. The man is surrounded by an oval frame with two coats of arms at the top corners. The background features plain engravings for texture.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: This image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual is facing the viewer directly, with distinguished facial features and a serene expression. They have curly hair neatly styled, covered by a headpiece, and are wearing a formal outfit with a wide collar and a cross pendant. The background is ornamented with fleur-de-lis emblems, with a coat of arms in the top left corner and a decorative design in the top right. The portrait is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Amador de la Porte
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, seated with a distinguished pose. He has neatly styled hair, a goatee, and is wearing a high-collared garment with a star emblem, and a lace or ruffled collar. In his right hand, he holds a pole or staff. He is framed by a circular border, with ships and a coastal city scene in the background, showing buildings, trees, and sea lines.

artworks.title: Christine of France
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman's bust. The woman is depicted facing slightly to her left, with detailed facial features, including an oval face, prominent eyebrows, and a poised expression. Her hair is styled in voluminous curls framing her face. She wears an elaborate dress with a large collar and puffed sleeves indicative of the period's fashion. The attire appears richly textured. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is a simple oval frame. The text below identifies her as Christine de France, Duchesse de Savoye.

artworks.title: François de Valois
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper body in profile facing to the left. He has distinct facial features, medium-length hair, and wears an ornate hat with feathers. He is dressed in an intricate doublet or cloak with a high collar. The background shows people on horseback and soldiers in armor, set in an outdoor scene with clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Raymond Lulle
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has a beard, mustache, and wavy hair. He is wearing a hat, cloak with a fur collar, and a scroll from his mouth with the words "Lux mea ars inveniendi." The background includes a detailed landscape with figures and architectural elements. The portrait is bordered by an oval frame with decorative emblems at the top corners. The text beneath the image includes the name 'B. Raymvdvs Lvllivs Philosophvs.'
